scripts.metrics: npm run build && (FORM=mobile STATIC_DIR=dist lhci autorun; m=$?; FORM=desktop STATIC_DIR=dist lhci autorun; d=$?; node metrics/disable-fireworks.mjs; node metrics/scroll-perf.mjs http://localhost:4321/ --serve "npm run preview" --budgets metrics/budgets.json --out metrics/scroll-desktop.json; s=$?; node metrics/scroll-perf.mjs http://localhost:4321/ --serve "npm run preview" --mobile --cpu 4 --budgets metrics/budgets.json --out metrics/scroll-mobile.json; t=$?; echo "метрики: mobile=$m desktop=$d scroll-desktop=$s scroll-mobile=$t"; [ $m -eq 0 ] && [ $d -eq 0 ] && [ $s -eq 0 ] && [ $t -eq 0 ])
